name: CvxRewardDistributor claimMultipleStaking
summary: claimMultipleStaking() did not check that entries of the claimContracts array were registered staking contracts, so a caller-supplied fake contract was invoked as a staking service and returned reward amounts that minted 58M CVG to the attacker.
notes: The proxy's sole pre-exploit Upgraded event selected the defect-bearing implementation during proxy deployment.
Gross swap proceeds transferred to the attacker in the exploit transaction. Asset amounts are exact token Transfer events; the aggregate USD value is reported by Verichains.
The USD value is reported rather than independently reconstructed from incident-time prices.
